summary: Cattle Call and FuRyu's classic-style JRPG about an uprising against Daemons, later remastered in HD.

entries.title: The Alliance Alive

emulation.emulator: None for primary; Lime3DS/Azahar for original 3DS comparison

primary.why: The HD Remastered release upgrades the 3DS game for modern platforms; the PC version is the best capture route among the HD releases.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Steam or GOG PC release with a controller. Use mobile only for portable convenience and 3DS only for original-version comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Use a controller for the PC release where required.
